memory-review.json.assessment: Reviewed all 144 groups (288 paired observations). 58 groups have positive mean RSS deltas, including 36 increasing in both rounds; 61 decrease in both. The largest positive mean is 159,744 bytes (2.09%) for array-dict/width2/once/JIT. All width2048/once groups decrease in both rounds; fresh snapshots and small owners show mixed changes. Accept these measured small peak-RSS increases alongside flat activation layouts and zero requested-allocation increases in the control matrices. They are retained explicitly, not dismissed as proven noise. This bounded two-entry journal has no growing retained cache; these observations do not prove absence of leaks or universal memory improvement. Loaded-host timings establish no competitive speed claim.

require 'json';require 'digest';require 'open3'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__);sha=->(p){Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest};bin=o+'/candidate-kujo';probe=o+'/task-allocation-probe'
r={status:'running',pid:Process.pid,identities:[bin,probe].to_h{|p|[p,sha.call(p)]},references:{},rows:[],semantics:[]};save=->{File.write(o+'/scalar-controls.json',JSON.pretty_generate(r)+"\n")};save.call
begin
 %w[scalar].each do |name|
  ref=o+'/baselines/'+name+'/report.json';b=JSON.parse(File.read(ref));r[:references][ref]=sha.call(ref)
  raise 'Baseline status' unless b['status']=='characterized'&&b['rows'].size==192&&b['semantics'].size==288
  b['identities'].merge(b['sources']).each{|p,h|raise 'Baseline drift' unless sha.call(p)==h}
  b['rows'].each do |row|
   args=[probe,row['mode'],row['path']];stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*args);m=stderr.match(/requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/)
   raise stdout+stderr unless status.success?&&stdout=="SCALAR FIRST PASS\n"&&m
   r[:rows]<<{baseline:row,argv:args,stdout:stdout,stderr:stderr,exit:status.exitstatus,requests:m[1].to_i,bytes:m[2].to_i};save.call
   next unless row['mode']=='vm'
   %w[vm interpreter jit].each do |mode|
    args=[bin,'run',row['path'],'--untrusted','--scheduler-no-timeout']+(mode=='vm' ? [] : ['--'+mode]);stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*args)
    raise stdout+stderr unless status.success?&&stdout=="SCALAR FIRST PASS\n"
    r[:semantics]<<{argv:args,stdout:stdout,stderr:stderr,exit:status.exitstatus};save.call
   end
  end
 end
 %w[vm interpreter jit].each do |mode|
  args=[bin,'run',o+'/scalar-contract/main.kujo','--untrusted']+(mode=='vm' ? [] : ['--'+mode]);stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*args)
  raise stdout+stderr unless status.success?&&stdout=="SCALAR BATCH CONTRACT PASS\n"
  (r[:contracts]||=[])<<{argv:args,stdout:stdout,stderr:stderr,exit:status.exitstatus}
 end
 raise 'Coverage' unless r[:rows].size==192&&r[:semantics].size==288
 r[:regressions]=r[:rows].select{|x|%w[requests bytes].any?{|k|x[k.to_sym]>x[:baseline][k]}}
 r[:slopes]=r[:rows].group_by{|x|x[:baseline].values_at('shape','width','snapshot','mode')}.map do |group,rows|
  a,b=rows.sort_by{|x|x[:baseline]['calls']}.last(2)
  {group:group,bytes:(b[:bytes]-a[:bytes])/16.0,requests:(b[:requests]-a[:requests])/16.0,baseline_bytes:(b[:baseline]['bytes']-a[:baseline]['bytes'])/16.0,baseline_requests:(b[:baseline]['requests']-a[:baseline]['requests'])/16.0}
 end
 r[:slope_regressions]=r[:slopes].select{|x|x[:bytes]>x[:baseline_bytes]||x[:requests]>x[:baseline_requests]}
 r[:identities].each{|p,h|raise 'Candidate drift' unless sha.call(p)==h}
 r[:status]=r[:regressions].empty?&&r[:slope_regressions].empty? ? 'passed' : 'failed';save.call;raise 'Allocation regressions require review' unless r[:status]=='passed'
rescue=>e;r[:status]='failed';r[:error]=e.message;save.call;raise
end

 form=x['group'][0];small=target['slopes'].find{|v|v['group']==[form,2,'once','vm']};raise 'Missing small owner' unless small

end

File.write('benchmarks/langarena/MIXED_PAIR_BATCHES_2026_10_30.md',<<~MD)
  # Mixed two-write array batches

  Runtime `#{commit}` stores eligible mixed two-write captured-array updates in a
  bounded two-entry journal. Scalar-first and collection-first updates transfer
  their pending writes without materializing the full owner. Numeric pairs and
  same-kind array/dictionary pairs retain their compact storage. The new mixed
  journal is boxed to preserve the capture-frame layout.

  Admission still checks bounds, ownership, supported values and observation
  boundaries. Real snapshots, callbacks, errors and ordinary publication remain
  authoritative. Two-element owners are included; no general aliasing or value
  semantics rule is weakened.

  ## Allocation results

  VM and JIT agree. With one initial snapshot, requested bytes per added call are:

  | Ordered payload pair | Baseline width 2 | Baseline width 2,048 | Candidate widths 2/3/8/2,048 |
  | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
  #{rows.join("\n")}

  Baseline is `94ad8f5`. Candidate slopes are flat across all four widths for
  every listed form. Fresh-snapshot cases are retained as separate controls;
  required snapshot copying is not claimed as removed. Most forms save one
  allocation request per added call; struct/scalar forms save three.
  These are allocation improvements, not elapsed-speed or clean-host claims.

  ## Verification

  - Target: 768 allocation pairs, 1,152 semantic checks and three portable
    runtime contracts.
  - Historical controls: 384 shape pairs / 576 semantic checks; 192 scalar pairs /
    288 checks; 288 batch pairs / 432 checks; 432 boundary pairs / 1,296 checks;
    432 fallback pairs / 648 checks.
  - Total: 2,496 allocation pairs and 4,392 semantic checks, with no total or
    slope allocation increases in these matrices, plus nine portable contracts.
    Seven corrupted target reports are rejected by the independent verifier.
  - 1,270 library tests passed, eight ignored; 418 integrations passed, one
    ignored. Exact prior test sets and the added tests are verified. The original harness
    passes 417 tests; a standalone integration adds one test for full two-entry
    promotion, plus six direct baseline/candidate runtime contracts.
  - All 150 test-size checksums passed: all 50 benchmarks in VM, interpreter
    and JIT. Formatting and diff checks passed.

  The first release attempt failed because the disk was full while writing a
  compiler object. Removing 2 GiB of reproducible debug artifacts allowed the
  unchanged source to build successfully. Original failure logs, commands,
  states and recovery evidence are retained. The extra promotion test initially omitted thin LTO; the linker rejected Rust
  dependency bitcode. Correcting that test-build flag allowed the unchanged test

  end

"if j == 1 { assert_equal(#{final}[j].value, #{calls+1}) } else { assert_equal(#{final}[j].value, 0) }" : "assert_equal(#{final}[j].value, 0)"} j += 1 }\n"

keys=%w[payload writes width snapshot calls mode];cases=%w[array mixed struct].product([3,8,64],[64,2048],%w[once fresh],[1,2,16,32])
raise 'Allocation coverage' unless r['rows'].map{|x|x.values_at(*keys)}.sort==cases.product(%w[vm jit]).map{|a,b|a+[b]}.sort

r['sources'].each{|h,s|raise 'Embedded source drift' unless Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(s)==h}
(r['rows']+r['semantics']).each do |x|
 p=fixtures+'/'+x.values_at(*keys.first(5)).join('-')+'/main.kujo'
 raise 'Fixture drift' unless sha.call(p)==x['source_sha256']&&sha.call(File.dirname(p)+'/owner.kujo')==x['module_sha256']
 if x.key?('exit')
  args=[binary,'run',p,'--untrusted','--scheduler-no-timeout'];args<<'--'+x['mode'] unless x['mode']=='vm'
  raise 'Semantic execution' unless x['exit']==0&&x['argv']==args
 else
  probes.each{|k,probe|raise 'Probe command' unless x[k]['argv']==[probe,x['mode'],p]}
 end
end

slopes=r['rows'].group_by{|x|x.values_at('payload','writes','width','snapshot','mode')}.flat_map do |g,rows|
 rows.sort_by{|x|x['calls']}.each_slice(2).map{|a,b|{group:g,calls:[a['calls'],b['calls']],baseline:%w[requests bytes].to_h{|k|[k,(b['baseline'][k]-a['baseline'][k]).fdiv(b['calls']-a['calls'])]},candidate:%w[requests bytes].to_h{|k|[k,(b['candidate'][k]-a['candidate'][k]).fdiv(b['calls']-a['calls'])]}}}
end
bad=slopes.select{|x|%w[requests bytes].any?{|k|x[:candidate][k]>x[:baseline][k]}}
target=slopes.select{|x|x[:group][3]=='once'&&x[:calls]==[16,32]}.group_by{|x|x[:group].values_at(0,1,4)}.map do |g,rows|
 small,large=rows.sort_by{|x|x[:group][2]}
 raise 'Width set' unless [small[:group][2],large[:group][2]]==[64,2048]
 {group:g,rows:rows,flat:small[:candidate]==large[:candidate],strict:large[:candidate]['bytes']<large[:baseline]['bytes']}
end
raise 'Target coverage' unless target.size==18
v={status:regressions.empty?&&bad.empty?&&target.all?{|x|x[:flat]} ? 'passed' : 'rejected',pairs:288,semantics:432,total_regressions:regressions,slope_regressions:bad,targets:target,slopes:slopes,report_sha256:sha.call(o+'/batch-controls/report.json'),verifier_sha256:sha.call(__FILE__)}
File.write(o+'/batch-verified.json',JSON.pretty_generate(v)+"\n")
raise "Rejected: #{regressions.size} totals / #{bad.size} slopes / targets=#{target.count{|x|x[:flat]}}" unless v[:status]=='passed'

require 'json';require 'digest'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__)
raise 'Broad tests incomplete' unless JSON.parse(File.read(o+'/continuation-state.json'))['status']=='review-pending'
raise 'Cold controls incomplete' unless JSON.parse(File.read(o+'/scalar-controls-verified.json'))['status']=='passed'
if File.file?(o+'/checksum-state.json')
 prior=nil
 loop do
  prior=JSON.parse(File.read(o+'/checksum-state.json'))
  break unless prior['status']=='running'
  raise 'Recursive checksum invocation' if prior['pid']==Process.pid
  begin;Process.kill(0,prior['pid']);rescue Errno::ESRCH;raise 'Checksum process gone; inspect retained evidence';end
  sleep 10
 end
 raise 'Previous checksum failure; inspect retained evidence' unless prior['status']=='passed'
 raise 'Source identity' unless system('ruby',o+'/verify-source.rb')
 JSON.parse(File.read(o+'/benchmark-source-manifest.json')).each{|p,h|raise 'Benchmark source drift '+p unless Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==h}
 expected=JSON.parse(File.read('benchmarks/langarena/test.json')).sort_by{|x|x['name']}
 raise 'Expected corpus cardinality' unless expected.size==50&&expected.map{|x|x['name']}.uniq.size==50
 %w[vm interpreter jit].each do |mode|
  r=JSON.parse(File.read(o+'/all50-'+mode+'.json'))
  raise 'Checksum identity' unless r['runtime']==mode&&r['binary']==o+'/candidate-kujo'
  raise 'Checksum corpus' unless r['results'].map{|x|x['config']}.sort_by{|x|x['name']}==expected
  r['results'].each do |x|
   lines=x['stdout'].lines.map(&:chomp)
   raise 'Checksum output' unless x['status']=='passed'&&x['exitcode']==0&&x['runtime']==mode&&x['name']==x['config']['name']&&!x['stdout_truncated']&&!x['stderr_truncated']&&lines.count(x['name']+': OK '+x['config']['checksum'].to_s)==1&&lines.count('Summary: 1, 1, 0')==1
  end
 end
 puts 'Reusing exact matching150-case checksum evidence'
 exit 0
end
s={status:'running',pid:Process.pid};
save=->{File.write(o+'/checksum-state.json',JSON.pretty_generate(s)+"\n")};save.call
begin
 raise 'Source identity' unless system('ruby',o+'/verify-source.rb',out:o+'/production-source-checksum.log',err:[:child,:out])
 b=JSON.parse(File.read(o+'/build-state.json'));raise 'Binary identity' unless Digest::SHA256.file(o+'/candidate-kujo').hexdigest==b['binary_sha256']
 sources=Dir.glob('benchmarks/langarena/**/*.kujo').push('benchmarks/langarena/test.json').to_h{|p|[p,Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest]}
 File.write(o+'/benchmark-source-manifest.json',JSON.pretty_generate(sources))
 %w[vm interpreter jit].each do |mode|
  s[:stage]=mode;save.call
  path=o+'/all50-'+mode+'.json';raise 'Output exists' if File.exist?(path)
  args=[o+'/candidate-kujo','run','benchmarks/langarena/profile.kujo','--scheduler-no-timeout',o+'/candidate-kujo','benchmarks/langarena/test.json',path,'600000',mode]
  File.write(o+'/all50-'+mode+'-argv.json',JSON.pretty_generate(args))
  raise 'Checksum runner '+mode unless system(*args,out:o+'/all50-'+mode+'.log',err:[:child,:out])
  r=JSON.parse(File.read(path));raise 'Checksum result '+mode unless r['results'].size==50&&r['results'].all?{|x|x['status']=='passed'}
 end
 sources.each{|p,h|raise 'Source drift' unless Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==h}
 s[:status]='passed';s[:stage]='all150';save.call
rescue=>e;s[:status]='failed';s[:error]=e.message;save.call;raise

require 'json'
require 'open3'
require 'tmpdir'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__)
r=JSON.parse(File.read(o+'/pair-controls.json'))
raise 'Target incomplete' unless r['status']=='passed'
mutations={
 'duplicate allocation row'=>->(x){x['rows'][-1]=x['rows'][0]},
 'missing semantic row'=>->(x){x['semantics'].pop},
 'raw counters differ'=>->(x){x['rows'][0]['requests']-=1},
 'baseline row substitution'=>->(x){x['rows'][0]['baseline']['bytes']+=1},
 'semantic command substitution'=>->(x){x['semantics'][0]['argv'][-1]='--interpreter'},
 'candidate identity substitution'=>->(x){x['identities'][x['identities'].keys.first]='0'*64},
 'semantic failure'=>->(x){x['semantics'][0]['exit']=4}
}
results=[]
Dir.mktmpdir('capture-verifier-') do |dir|
 mutations.each do |name,mutate|
  x=Marshal.load(Marshal.dump(r));mutate.call(x);path=dir+'/report.json';File.write(path,JSON.generate(x))
  stdout,stderr,s=Open3.capture3('ruby',o+'/verify-pair-controls.rb',path)
  raise 'Corruption accepted: '+name if s.success?
  results<<{case:name,exit:s.exitstatus,stdout:stdout,stderr:stderr}
 end
end
File.write(o+'/verifier-rejections.json',JSON.pretty_generate({status:'passed',results:results})+"\n")
puts "#{results.size} corrupt reports rejected"

require 'json'; require 'digest'; require 'open3'; require 'fileutils'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__); out=o+'/boundary-controls'; raise 'Output exists' if File.exist?(out); FileUtils.mkdir_p(out)
b=File.expand_path('../string-first-candidate-2026-10-30',o)
r={status:'running',pid:Process.pid,rows:[],semantics:[],sources:{},identities:{}}
save=->{File.write(out+'/report.json',JSON.pretty_generate(r)+"\n")};save.call
begin
 bins={'baseline'=>b+'/candidate-kujo','candidate'=>o+'/candidate-kujo'}
 probes={'baseline'=>b+'/task-allocation-probe','candidate'=>o+'/task-allocation-probe'}
 (bins.values+probes.values+[__FILE__]).each{|p|r[:identities][p]=Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest}
 %w[array mixed struct].product([3,8,2048],%w[early_error late_error invalid read callback scalar], [1,2,16,32]).each do |kind,width,scenario,calls|
  payload=->(n,i){kind=='struct' ? "Item { value: #{n} }" : kind=='mixed'&&i.odd? ? "{\"value\": #{n}}" : "[#{n}]"}
  read=->(obj,i){kind=='struct' ? "#{obj}[#{i}].value" : kind=='mixed'&&i.odd? ? "#{obj}[#{i}][\"value\"]" : "#{obj}[#{i}][0]"}
  writes=(0..2).map{|i|"state[#{i}] = #{payload.call('n',i)}"}.join("\n")
  body=case scenario
  when 'early_error' then "state[0] = #{payload.call('n / 0',0)}\n#{writes}"
  when 'late_error' then "#{writes}\nstate[0] = #{payload.call('n / 0',0)}"
  when 'invalid' then "#{writes}\nstate[#{width}] = #{payload.call('n',0)}"
  when 'read' then "#{writes}\nlet seen := state\nassert_equal(#{read.call('seen',2)}, n)"
  when 'callback' then "#{writes}\nobserve(n)"
  when 'scalar' then "#{writes}\nstate[0] = n + 0.5 state[1] = true state[2] = \"done\""
  end
  owner="struct Item { value: int }\nmut state := [] mut key := 0\nwhile key < #{width} { state = push(state, #{payload.call('0',0)}) key += 1 }\nexport func snapshot() { return state }\nfunc observe(n) { assert_equal(#{read.call('state',0)}, n) assert_equal(#{read.call('state',2)}, n) }\nexport func edit(n) { #{body}\nreturn n }\n"
  failure=%w[early_error late_error invalid].include?(scenario)
  call=failure ? 'try { edit(count) } except err { caught += 1 }' : 'edit(count)'
  checks=if scenario=='scalar'
   "assert_equal(result[0], #{calls}+0.5) assert_equal(result[1], true) assert_equal(result[2], \"done\")"
  elsif scenario=='early_error'
   (0..2).map{|i|"assert_equal(#{kind=='struct' ? "result[#{i}].value" : "result[#{i}][0]"}, 0)"}.join("\n")
  else
   (0..2).map{|i|"assert_equal(#{read.call('result',i)}, #{calls})"}.join("\n")
  end
  initial=kind=='struct' ? 'original[0].value' : 'original[0][0]'
  source="from owner import edit, snapshot\nlet original := snapshot()\nmut count := 1 mut caught := 0\nwhile count <= #{calls} { #{call}\ncount += 1 }\nassert_equal(caught, #{failure ? calls : 0})\nlet result := snapshot()\n#{checks}\nassert_equal(#{initial}, 0)\nprint(\"BATCH BOUNDARY PASS\")\n"
  dir=out+"/#{kind}-#{width}-#{scenario}-#{calls}";FileUtils.mkdir_p(dir);path=dir+'/main.kujo';module_path=dir+'/owner.kujo';File.write(path,source);File.write(module_path,owner)
  [path,module_path].each{|p|r[:sources][p]=Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest}
  meta={kind:kind,width:width,scenario:scenario,calls:calls,path:path}
  bins.each do |version,bin|
   %w[vm interpreter jit].each do |mode|
    argv=[bin,'run',path,'--untrusted','--scheduler-no-timeout'];argv<<'--'+mode unless mode=='vm'
    stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*argv);raise "#{meta}/#{version}/#{mode}: #{stdout} #{stderr}" unless status.success?&&stdout=="BATCH BOUNDARY PASS\n"
    r[:semantics]<<meta.merge(version:version,mode:mode,argv:argv,exit:status.exitstatus)
   end
  end
  %w[vm jit].each do |mode|
   row=meta.merge(mode:mode)
   probes.each do |version,probe|
    argv=[probe,mode,path];stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*argv);m=stderr.match(/ALLOCATION_AUDIT requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/)
    raise "#{meta}/#{version}/#{mode}: #{stdout} #{stderr}" unless status.success?&&stdout=="BATCH BOUNDARY PASS\n"&&m
    row[version]={argv:argv,requests:m[1].to_i,bytes:m[2].to_i}
   end
   r[:rows]<<row
  end
  save.call
 end
 r[:identities].merge(r[:sources]).each{|p,h|raise 'Identity drift' unless Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==h}
 raise 'Coverage' unless r[:rows].size==432&&r[:semantics].size==1296
 r[:regressions]=r[:rows].select{|x|%w[requests bytes].any?{|k|x['candidate'][k.to_sym]>x['baseline'][k.to_sym]}}
 r[:status]='characterized';save.call
rescue=>e;r[:status]='failed';r[:error]=e.message;save.call;raise
end
